replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Not often. While physics and philosophy frustrate me, math is straightforward. Its rules are clear, so I handle it without stress.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: Yes, I used an AI tool to refresh algebra for a project. It was helpful for quick solutions, but I still rely on textbooks for deep understanding.
replies.How would you explain, step by step, how: First, write the equation in standard form ax² + bx + c = 0. Calculate discriminant (b²-4ac). If positive, use quadratic formula to find two real roots. If zero, one real root. If negative, complex roots.
